title: Instant tab switches
items: Tabs open at once: the fade and card rise on every switch are gone, and so is the bar-growth animation on probability bars. On a return to Games or Results the fade alone held the switch for up to half a second.

Rankings, Conference standings, Research, Results, Scorecard and Games are built in the background while the page is idle, so a first visit opens as fast as a return. On the basketball board Rankings' first visit went from about 1.7s to under 10ms.
A tab whose content is a minute old opens as it stands and refreshes right after it is on screen, instead of being rebuilt before it shows.

The team ratings table works out the games behind each team's move once per edition instead of once per row: the basketball table builds in about 60ms, down from about 800ms, with the same games and chances.
